description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2940013612407 FILTER ELEMENT,INTAKE: Line 0001 Qty 484 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0034 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). Quotes must be submitted electronically.
